final: SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS inventory_count, COUNT(i.inventory_id) - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT f2.film_id, f2.rating, COUNT(i2.inventory_id) AS cnt FROM film f2 LEFT JOIN inventory i2 ON f2.film_id = i2.film_id GROUP BY f2.film_id, f2.rating) t) AS deviation_from_overall_avg, COUNT(i.inventory_id) - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT f2.film_id, f2.rating, COUNT(i2.inventory_id) AS cnt FROM film f2 LEFT JOIN inventory i2 ON f2.film_id = i2.film_id GROUP BY f2.film_id, f2.rating) t) AS final_deviation FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating ORDER BY final_deviation DESC LIMIT 10
